rationale: Static algebraic GHK-type relation with Gouy-Chapman surface-potential corrections; analyze_expression shows no derivatives/integrals/applied functions and Vm appears only linearly on the LHS, so the record is explicit (evaluate_explicit), not implicit. Co is the natural independent axis (varied external ion concentration); all other symbols are fixed physical constants/parameters set to physiological values (K+-like monovalent ion, T=310 K). The new term relative to the parent is the internal-side surface-charge Boltzmann factor placed in the GHK denominator, which shifts Vm by up to ~53 mV over the sampled range. sigma=1 mV keeps this and the overall log response well above 5*sigma while remaining small vs the tens-of-mV signal.

scenario_text: A resting cell membrane maintains an electrical potential that depends on the ratio of external to internal permeant ion concentrations. As the external ion concentration is varied, the equilibrium membrane potential shifts logarithmically. We record the resting potential as a function of the external ion concentration. Ion permeabilities and internal concentration are held fixed.
